name: Hannah Wright
source:
A University student with a passion for science and chemistry in particular.

She's always honest and isn't afraid to say what's on her mind, which isn't usually well-liked by people around her. That's not a problem though, because she enjoys being a loner and could spend an entire day reading on her bed.

Despite all this, she still managed to make two wonderful friends who will help her on her journey of self-acceptance.
